name: Uckerland (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Uckerland (a yellow rose with a ring of discs on red).
history: Municipal flag of Uckerland; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Uckerland arms — yellow rose on red
